Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study focuses on the development of Cys-LoC and Cys-LOx methods. The primary biological comparison for the Cys-LOx application is the stimulation of iBMDMs with LPS and IFNγ to study the mitochondrial redoxome. Cycloheximide (CHX) and dialyzed FBS were used as methodological optimizations to improve TurboID specificity and are not the primary biological variables of the differential proteomics analysis.
